name: L. A. von Hoffman
role: Baron; New York banker, father-in-law of the Marquis de Mores
bio: Baron L. A. von Hoffman appears in the Cow Boy chiefly as a visitor tied to the Marquis de Mores, whom an August 1884 article described as son-in-law of the New York banker von Hoffman; in February 1884 he was listed as treasurer among the officers of the N. P. Ref. Car Co. In August and September 1884 the Baron came for a long stay at Medora, watched cattle shipped at Dickinson, travelled west with the Baroness in their special car, and in October left for St. Paul with the Marquis in the special car Livingston.
